messages:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] GPU error-rate surge detected in us-west2 and eu-central. ECC events/sec x3.1, Xid errors x6.8 vs baseline. Estimated capacity impact ~18%. P50 gen latency +45ms. Dash: https://grafana.company/gpu-health/2076543210 :rotating_light:

alex: seeing it in the dashboard, confirming logs now. which clusters are hot? :eyes:

monitoring-bot: affected pools: usw2-gpu-pool-a (rack7), eu-central-gpu-pool-d (rack3). Node-level error counts: gnode-7-14 (Xid 12), gnode-7-15 (Xid 9), gnode-eu3-03 (Xid 8).

jen: ok - immediate mitigation: pause new allocations to those pools, start targeted drains for nodes with Xid >= 5. I'll own the drain plan for rack7.

paul: customer impact? autoscaler may try to refill, we should set a blackout on autoscale to avoid cascading provisioning. Also what's the cost exposure if we shift traffic to other regions?

oncall: tagging autoscaler: set policy blackhole for pools: `patch /autoscale/pools/{usw2-gpu-pool-a,eu-central-gpu-pool-d} --scale-disabled true` (running now).

alex: ops, paste of recent kernel messages from gnode-7-14 (last 5m):
```
[ 123456.789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 123457.001] ce_err: corrected error on KRNL0: ECC multi-bit, location=0x2f
[ 123458.120] watchdog: gpu_reset: triggered
```

jen: that matches flakey PCI/NVLink resets. Probable hardware degradation on that cohort. Plan: drain -> reprovision to spare rack -> mark for follow-up replacement. SRE-lead, we need a fast replacement window for racks 7 & 3.

sre-lead: agree. immediate steps: 1) shift steady-state traffic to regional fallback (us-east2) using smart-routing, 2) drain nodes with highest Xid counts, 3) enable model-fallback (quantized variant) on latency-sensitive routes for 30m. Alex, Paul, can you confirm routing and model fallback?

paul: routing change in progress: `routingctl route-mod --from=usw2 --to=use2 --percent=60` (kicking off). Will monitor token churn. Cost estimate: extra 60% cross-region adds ~15% infra spend for next 2 hours if sustained.

alex: model-fallback toggled for key routes `chat-gen` and `completion-64` to quantized variants. Rolling for 30m. Latency metric should normalize.

infra-automation-bot: drain job started for gnode-7-14, gnode-7-15, gnode-eu3-03. Commands: `drain-node --id gnode-7-14 --reason "Xid>5, ECC spike" --evacuate true`. ETA per node ~6-12 min.

oncall: I opened INC-207654 for tracking, assigned to eng-infra oncall. Notifying support to expect customer tickets.

jen: while drains run, collect `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,PERF` dumps and push to /var/log/gpu-health/2076543210/. Also capture `lspci -vv` for nodes that fail reprovision.

alex: pushed dumps. sample file: `/var/log/gpu-health/2076543210/gnode-7-14-ecc.txt` uploaded. Attaching small excerpt: `ECC multi-bit count: 18, last-corrected-ts: 2026-03-17T15:03:12Z`.

paul: autoscaler kept one small refill attempt; manually aborted. Good catch.

monitoring-bot: update: after drains and routing shift, error-rate down 70% in 12m, estimated capacity impact reduced to 6%. Continuing to watch.

sre-lead: plan for replacement: submit hardware replacement tickets for rack7 cards with Xid>5, schedule maintenance window tomorrow 0100-0300 UTC for eu-central follow-up.

infra-automation-bot: replacement ticket created: HW-TKT-8921. Spare inventory: 4 GPUs available in usw2 spare pool.

oncall: support notified, customers on affected nodes emailed with note and incident link.

jen: leave nodes cordoned until after hardware swap. We'll run stress + memory tests before uncordon.

alex: FYI: a small subset of nodes show corrected ECC but repeated resets => likely PSU or riser. Flagging to hw-vendors.

monitoring-bot: standing alert persists (severity: elevated). Next check-in in 10m.

paul: noted cost policy: if cross-region routing >50% for >2h, escalate to finance for pre-approvals. For now, we cap at 2h fallback.

jen: thanks team. keep threads tight, drop notes in INC-207654. I'll update after hardware confirmations. :white_check_mark:
